hints.title: Match the first and last terms
hints.body: The cube of ax+b starts with a3x3 and ends with b3. Compare these with the given cubic before considering the middle terms.
hints.recap: Coefficients of equal powers must agree when two polynomials are identical.
hints.pitfall: The final constant is negative, so its real cube root is negative too.
hints.pause: Find a and b from the cubic coefficient and constant term.

recall.reminder: Coefficients of equal powers must agree when two polynomials are identical.

hints.title: Choose the coefficient of x squared
hints.body: In (ax+b)3, the coefficient of x2 is 3a2b. Use the values of the two constants that you obtain by matching the leading and constant terms.
hints.recap: There are three ways to choose b from one bracket and ax from the other two.
hints.pitfall: The coefficient is 3a squared times b, not 3a times b squared: that belongs to the x term.
hints.pause: Determine both constants from the end coefficients and then calculate the coefficient of x squared.

recall.reminder: There are three ways to choose b from one bracket and ax from the other two.

hints.title: Read the sign attached to the parameter
hints.body: Compare your calculated x-squared coefficient with the entire coefficient printed in the question, including the minus sign attached to the parameter.
hints.recap: A parameter may appear with an extra sign; equate the entire coefficient.
hints.pitfall: A negative coefficient of x squared does not mean p is negative when the expression already contains minus p.
hints.pause: Complete the coefficient calculation, solve for the parameter and check the x coefficient.

recall.reminder: A parameter may appear with an extra sign; equate the entire coefficient.

solution:
1. Match the end terms. a3=8 and b3=−33, so a=2 and b=−3.

2. Select the x-squared coefficient. In the expansion, this is 3a2b=3(2)2(−3)=−123.

3. Equate the complete coefficients. −p=−123, hence p=123. As a check, the x coefficient is 3ab2=3(2)(3)=18, as required.

Answer H.
